text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Two doses of measles-containing vaccine conferred about 97 percent protection against measles infection in controlled effectiveness studies.","cited_pids":["vaccines_measles#0"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"Neutralising antibody titres against measles persist for decades after the standard two-dose vaccination schedule.","cited_pids":["vaccines_measles#3"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"National measles incidence fell by more than 99 percent after routine childhood vaccination was introduced.","cited_pids":["vaccines_measles#1"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"Regions with sustained high measles vaccination coverage interrupted endemic transmission.","cited_pids":["vaccines_measles#4"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"Measles outbreaks concentrate among unvaccinated individuals.","cited_pids":["vaccines_measles#2"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Measles resurgence follows declines in vaccination coverage.","cited_pids":["vaccines_measles#7"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Measles vaccination within 72 hours of exposure reduces the probability of developing clinical disease.","cited_pids":["vaccines_measles#6"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"No retrieved passages contradict the finding that measles vaccines prevent measles infection.","cited_pids":[]}]}
